context.browserContext: Existing expense PDF preview inspected in the in-app browser; its previous content selection and closed state restored.

options.prompt: Design a refined two-metric summary component for TripLOG’s expense report at 1086 × 262 pixels. Direction: an open editorial two-column layout. Design a refined two-metric summary component for TripLOG’s expense report at 1086 × 262 pixels. Direction: a compact two-row report summary on one white paper surface.
